notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) — building in-product assistant + search + reranking for recommendations. Started on Hosted API to validate quality, now moving to Dedicated for predictable latency and cost.

Key quotes / takeaways:
- Head of Product: "Need a predictable p95 for chat interactions and a clear rollback plan if quality regresses."
- CTO: "We prefer Dedicated but need a canary and a fallback to hosted during peak or incidents."

Technical requirements (from calls):
- Workloads: session chat (short-turn latency), doc-search embeddings index refresh (offline), reranking for top-10 results.
- Targets: p95 latency <= 120ms for chat tokens (short prompts), sustained throughput ~50 qps during peak, cold-start warmup acceptable for embeddings batch jobs.
- Model preference: open models with option for quantized variants; willing to test fp16 vs 4-bit quantized variants for cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Routing/HA: need regional failover (primary us-east-1, fallback us-west-2), and an automatic fallback to Hosted API (lower-priority) if Dedicated pool congested.

POC ask: 2-week Dedicated POC focusing on canary deployment + fallback routing. POC deliverables:
- Dedicated test pool with 2 GPUs (dedicated), deploy two model variants (v1: fp16 base, v1-q: 4-bit quantized),
- Canary traffic plan: 10% -> 25% -> 100% over 10 business days if metrics stable, with ability to rollback to previous model within 5 minutes.
- Fallback routing: on error rate >1% or p95 degradation >20% for 10m, route new chat sessions to Hosted API model variant or smaller model in Dedicated pool.
- Region failover: health checks + standby pool in us-west-2; automated DNS/route failover with warm KV cache seeding.

Quality & monitoring KPIs requested by customer:
- p95 latency, mean tokens/sec, error rate, cost per 1k tokens, relevance delta on a small eval suite (internal prompt set).
- Regression alerting: auto rollback if relevance drops >5% vs baseline or error rate spikes.

Commercial notes:
- Customer is cost-conscious but values predictable spend and SLA. Prefers a committed reserved plan with burst capacity.
- Initial estimate shared: committed monthly reserved pool to cover baseline traffic ~3-4 GPUs; POC to validate scaling and exact commit.

Next blockers to resolve:
- Legal: DPA and data residency language for EU data.
- Infra: SAML SSO testing window (their infra team needs 2 weeks).
- Pricing: need final SOW with committed GPU-month pricing and overage terms.

Links: pricing deck (drive link), security QA spreadsheet (drive), call transcripts (Fireflies ids).

poc_plan: Provision Dedicated test pool (2 x A10G-equivalent) in us-east-1 (isolated VPC).
Deploy model variants: release/v1 (fp16) and release/v1-q (4-bit quantized).
Canary rollout: 10% traffic for 48h -> 25% for 72h -> 100% if stable; monitoring window at each step.
Metric gates: p95 latency, error rate, relevance score on eval set; rollback if any gate fails twice within gate window.
Fallback routing: implement policy to route to Hosted API model variant or smaller local model when Dedicated capacity constrained or errors exceed threshold.
Region failover: keep warm standby in us-west-2 with KV-cache seeding job; failover automated with DNS + health-checks; rollback plan to primary when healthy.
